proofs.locator: Theorem 3.1 Proof, PDF pp7–8 / printed pp54–55, equations (2)–(11)
map: For gamma=1 the source treats the bound as immediate. For 0<gamma<1 use p_i>=gamma/K, sum_i p_i hat{x}_i=x_{I_t}, and sum_i p_i hat{x}_i^2<=sum_i hat{x}_i, equations (2)–(4).

With W_t=sum_i w_i(t), rewrite w_i/W_t=(p_i-gamma/K)/(1-gamma). Apply exp(z)<=1+z+(e-2)z^2 at z=gamma hat{x}_i/K in [0,1], then log(1+u)<=u. Equation (9) gives log(W_{T+1}/W_1)<=gamma G_Exp3/[K(1-gamma)]+(e-2)gamma^2 sum_{t,i}hat{x}_i(t)/[K^2(1-gamma)].

For each fixed action j, log(W_{T+1}/W_1)>=gamma sum_t hat{x}_j(t)/K-ln K. Combining and weakening the logarithmic penalty yields equation (10): G_Exp3>=(1-gamma)sum_t hat{x}_j(t)-K ln K/gamma-(e-2)gamma sum_{t,i}hat{x}_i(t)/K.
Take expectations using equation (11), E[hat{x}_i(t)|I_1,...,I_{t-1}]=x_i(t). Choose a maximizing fixed j and use sum_{t,i}x_i(t)<=K Gmax to obtain the stated bound.

proofs.locator: Corollary 3.2 Proof, PDF p6 through first line of p7 / printed pp53–54
map: Let A=K ln K>0. If 0<g<=A/(e-1), then gamma=1 and weak regret<=Gmax<=g<=2 sqrt((e-1)gA).
Otherwise gamma=sqrt(A/((e-1)g))<1. Apply Theorem 3.1 and Gmax<=g: (e-1)gamma Gmax+A/gamma<=2 sqrt((e-1)gA). The source records 2 sqrt(e-1)<=2.63.
proofs.omitted_details: Source-linked short Proof recorded completely on the explicitly restricted nondegenerate tuning domain; no local theorem or boundary extension is asserted.
proofs.reading_coverage: Actually read and visually checked the Corollary statement and Proof on PDF p6 and its completion on p7.

assumptions: The reward assignment is fixed independently of the player's action draws; every reward lies in [0,1].
K is known; Exp3 observes only the selected reward and uses the displayed initialization, sampling and updates with a constant gamma.
For the recorded tuned Corollary 3.2 branch, additionally K>=2 and a finite positive public g>=Gmax(T) is available before choosing gamma.
statement.conclusion: Theorem 3.1: Gmax(T)-E[G_Exp3(T)] <= (e-1)gamma Gmax(T)+(K ln K)/gamma. Corollary 3.2 on the stated nondegenerate domain: choosing gamma=min{1,sqrt(K ln K/((e-1)g))} gives Gmax(T)-E[G_Exp3(T)] <= 2 sqrt(e-1) sqrt(g K ln K) <= 2.63 sqrt(g K ln K). The source's displayed tuning formula needs a boundary convention at K=1 or g=0; no such convention or tuned assertion is added here.
statement.objects_and_definitions: K actions indexed 1,...,K; fixed arbitrary rewards x(t)=(x_1(t),...,x_K(t)) in [0,1]^K. Figure 1 Exp3 has w_i(1)=1, p_i(t)=(1-gamma)w_i(t)/sum_j w_j(t)+gamma/K, I_t sampled from p(t), hat{x}_i(t)=1{I_t=i}x_i(t)/p_i(t), and w_i(t+1)=w_i(t)exp(gamma hat{x}_i(t)/K). Define G_Exp3(T)=sum_{t=1}^T x_{I_t}(t) and Gmax(T)=max_i sum_{t=1}^T x_i(t). ln is the natural logarithm and e its base.
statement.parameter_domains: Theorem 3.1: K in positive integers, T in positive integers, 0<gamma<=1. Recorded Corollary 3.2: K>=2, T>=1, finite real g>0 with g>=Gmax(T).
statement.quantifiers_and_randomness: For every positive integer K, every positive integer T, every fixed reward assignment, and every real gamma in (0,1], Theorem 3.1 bounds Gmax(T)-E[G_Exp3(T)]. Expectation is over all Exp3 action draws. For each K>=2, T and positive g bounding that assignment's Gmax(T), the separately tuned run satisfies the corollary.
